# Town of Barnard municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 2; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Barnard official website, Selectboard page: 'Current Selectboard members are Rock Webster, Richard Lancaster, and Kurt Lessard.' The Secretary of State's Selectboard Members directory publishes no Barnard roster ('Contact the Town Clerk for more information').

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): lists Selectboard members Kurt Lessard, Richard Lancaster, and Rock Webster.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Diane Rainey as Town Clerk of Barnard.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact information spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Diane Rainey as Town Clerk of Barnard.
Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): lists 'Town Clerk (3-year): Diane L. Rainey.'
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Diane Rainey as Town Treasurer of Barnard.

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): lists 'Treasurer (3-year): Diane L. Rainey.' The Secretary of State's treasurer contact spreadsheet prints no Barnard treasurer ('Contact Town Clerk for more information').
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting.

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): lists 'Moderator (1-year): Paul Doton' with a term expiring in 2026; he was elected at the March 4, 2025 annual meeting. No official source publishes the outcome of the 2026 annual meeting's moderator election, so no holder is recorded.

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): lists Auditors (3-year) Beth Finlayson (term expiring 2027) and Tom Morse (term expiring 2028); Patricia Hasson is listed with a term expiring in 2026. Finlayson is the justice of the peace listing's 'Elizabeth Finlayson.'
Town of Barnard Selectboard minutes, March 4, 2026 (the board's first meeting after the 2026 annual Town Meeting), item 8A: 'Chip Davis was elected at Town Meeting to be one of three auditors.'
Town of Barnard Selectboard minutes, March 4, 2026, item 8A: 'Chip Davis was elected at Town Meeting to be one of three auditors.'

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): lists 'Delinquent Tax Collector (1-year): Diane L. Rainey' with a term expiring in 2026 — the town elects the office separately (17 V.S.A. section 2651d). No official source publishes the outcome of the 2026 annual meeting, so no holder is recorded.

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): lists 'Constables (1-year): 1st Wes Hennig' with a term expiring in 2026. No official source publishes the outcome of the 2026 annual meeting, so no holder is recorded.

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): lists 'Constables (1-year): 2nd Edwin Cole' with a term expiring in 2026. No official source publishes the outcome of the 2026 annual meeting, so no holder is recorded.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting.

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): names no grand juror in its elected or appointed officers tables, and no other official source publishes the holder.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent to prosecute and defend suits at annual town meeting.

Town of Barnard, 2026 Town Report (FY25 Annual Report, July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025), 'TOWN OFFICERS ELECTED' table (report page 4): names no town agent in its elected or appointed officers tables, and no other official source publishes the holder.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists four Barnard justices of the peace: Paul Doton, Patricia Hasson, Elizabeth Finlayson, and Ellen Miles.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists four Barnard justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term (Paul Doton, Patricia Hasson, Elizabeth Finlayson, Ellen Miles); they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
